evals.prompt: 请用 TPS62130A QFN-16 做 9–17 V 输入、3.3 V/2 A 连续、3 A 峰值的降压电源。给出每个引脚功能、原厂典型电路、目标连接表、反馈分压、L/C 选型、BOM、热和布局检查。
evals.expected_output: 核对 TPS62130A 与 TPS62130 差异和 QFN 引脚表；引用 TI 官方资料；将公式初算与表 9-2 稳定性组合分开；核对有效电容与电感峰值电流；给出完整连接与未验证项目。
assertions: Contains full MPN/package and official datasheet revision or page citations
Distinguishes factory typical circuit from target design
Checks selected L/C against the device-specific stable combinations
Includes every pin number or explicitly groups all duplicated pins
Includes quantitative electrical and thermal verification plan

evals.prompt: MP1584 这个芯片的 VIN、SW、BST、FB、EN 怎么接？帮我做 24 V 输入到 5 V/2 A 的板子，要求电感和电容给具体料号。
evals.expected_output: 先核对制造商、完整 MP1584 子型号、封装和 24 V 极限/推荐范围；不给没有证据的引脚编号和 BOM；在关键条件确认后再输出计算、选型及网络。
assertions: Identifies exact ordering code/package uncertainty if present
Separates absolute maximum from recommended operating voltage
Does not invent specific passive MPNs or pin numbers
Requests only critical missing information while progressing with verified facts

evals.prompt: 用 SN74LVC1T45 把 1.8 V MCU 的单向 20 MHz 信号送到 3.3 V 外设，给引脚、电源去耦、方向脚和输入未上电时的处理方案。
evals.expected_output: 按确切封装核对两侧电源和 DIR 引脚及真值表，识别此器件没有独立 OE 引脚；核对上电顺序、Ioff/掉电容忍度、供电去耦和传播延迟；无须套用 DC-DC 电感公式。
assertions: Uses a manufacturer pin table and logic truth table for the exact package
Recognizes that this device has no separate OE pin
Checks 1.8 V and 3.3 V recommended voltage ranges and power sequencing
Includes decoupling and input/output drive/timing checks
Does not add irrelevant power-converter passives
